title_source: Eric Wu’s newest company, out of stealth since May, is going after construction’s labor crunch
summary_source: Eric Wu, who built and ran Opendoor before stepping away in 2022, has had his new company, NavigateAI, out of stealth since May — building AI copilots that give construction workers real-time, hands-free guidance through smartphones and Meta's AI glasses, backed by $25 million from Elad Gil, Khosla Ventures, and Lennar to tackle a labor shortage severe enough that data center projects alone now need 4,000 to 5,000 workers apiece.

summary_ja: Opendoorを構築し経営し、2022年に退任する前にOpendoorを運営していたエリック・ウー氏は、5月から新会社NavigateAIをステルス状態から脱却した。データセンタープロジェクトだけで現在4,000人から5,000人が必要なほど深刻な人手不足に対処するため、Elad Gil、Khosla Ventures、Lennarから2,500万ドルの支援を受けて、スマートフォンとメタのAIメガネを介して建設作業員にリアルタイムでハンズフリーの指導を与えるAI副操縦士を構築している。それぞれの労働者。

title_en: [On-site] “Financial sector must verify external data and code for safe security”
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] “External data models and code verification are very important for a safe security environment.” Kim Seong-woong, head of the Financial AI Security Research Institute under the Financial Security Institute, said this at a breakfast seminar for CISOs and CPOs in the financial sector held by MarkAny on the 8th. title_ja: 済州「エネルギーゼロ村」造成…太陽光・ESS・ヒートポンプ、AI統合管理
summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア]太陽光・風力など再生エネルギーとエネルギー貯蔵装置（ESS）・電気自動車・ヒートポンプなどを人工知能（AI）に統合管理する「ゼロエネルギー村」造成事業が済州で推進される。分散エネルギー事業の種類の実証を済州で優先推進すると明らかにした。増えると予想され、分散エネルギー事業タイプ（モデル）実証最適な条件を整えた」と背景を説明した。需給を効率的に調節する「エネルギーゼロ住宅団地」構築だ。個々の住宅で生産して残る電力は、村が一緒に分けて使って、電気料金の低い時間帯を活用して設備が自ら稼働時点を調整する。
title_en: Creation of Jeju ‘Zero Energy Village’… Solar power, ESS, heat pump, AI integrated management
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] A project to create a 'zero energy village' that integrates and manages renewable energy such as solar power and wind power, energy storage devices (ESS), electric vehicles, and heat pumps with artificial intelligence (AI) is being promoted in Jeju. The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment announced that it will first promote the demonstration of various distributed energy business types selected through the '2026 AI-based distributed energy specialized region support project' contest in Jeju. An official from the Ministry of Climate Affairs said, "Jeju Island is a residential heat pump. He explained the background by saying, “As the distribution project begins in earnest, heating electrification in the residential sector will proceed at the fastest pace in the country,” and “With the electric vehicle penetration rate at 12.2% (as of the end of August 2026), the highest in the country, the amount of electricity used in homes is expected to continue to increase, creating the optimal conditions for demonstrating the type (model) of distributed energy business.” The type of project being promoted in Jeju this year is targeting houses in the Jeju area (about 20 households in Hallim-eup or Daejeong-eup). The goal is to build a ‘zero energy housing complex’ that connects solar power, heat pumps, electric vehicles, ESS, and AI home appliances into one system to manage the power produced and consumed in the village in real time and efficiently control supply and demand. The remaining electricity produced by individual houses is shared with the village, and facilities automatically adjust their operating times by utilizing times when electricity rates are low.

title_source: 통신비 못내 휴대전화 끊겨도 ‘109’ 연결된다

title_ja: 通信費せずに携帯電話を切っても「109」つながる
summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア]通信料金未納で携帯電話の発信が停止された利用者も今後自殺予防相談電話「109」に電話をかけられるようになる。 109を112や119のような緊急通信用電話に指定し、制度整備が終わる前の10月1日から優先適用することにした。経済的困難で通信料金が出せず携帯電話の発信が停止し、109を利用することが難しいという意見が大統領府SNSに受け付けられたことによる措置だ。関係省庁は現行制度を検討した後、通信サービスが制限された利用者も自殺予防相談を受けることができるように改善案を設けた。利用者が通話料を負担しない受信者負担方式だが、これまでは緊急通信用電話に指定されていない。このため、通信料金の延滞などで携帯電話の発信自体が制限されると、無料電話である109にも接続できない死角地帯があった。政府は今回の措置で料金未納による発信停止の有無にかかわらず…。
title_en: Even if your cell phone is disconnected due to non-payment of communication fees, you can still connect to ‘109’
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Users whose mobile phone calls have been suspended due to non-payment of communication fees will now be able to call the suicide prevention hotline ‘109’. It was decided to designate 109 as an emergency communication phone, like 112 or 119, and to apply it first from October 1, before the system overhaul is completed. The Ministry of Science and ICT, the Ministry of Health and Welfare, and the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission announced that they will pursue the designation of 109 as an emergency communication phone so that counseling can be received regardless of the communication status of the mobile phone in a suicide crisis situation.
